# Scrobble.dev

> Open knowledge for scrobbling, media tracking, interoperability, and portable media history.

Canonical site: https://scrobble.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/Electric-Town/scrobble.dev

## Core knowledge
- What is scrobbling?: https://scrobble.dev/learn/scrobbling/
- Working interoperability principles: https://scrobble.dev/standard/
- Floppy reference implementation: https://scrobble.dev/projects/floppy/
- Contribution guide: https://scrobble.dev/contribute/

## Machine-readable knowledge
- OKF bundle index: https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/index.md
- Scrobbling concept: https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/concepts/scrobbling.md
- Scrobble event concept: https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/concepts/scrobble-event.md
- Identity and mappings: https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/concepts/media-identity.md
- Interoperability: https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/concepts/interoperability.md

## Reference projects
- Floppy: https://github.com/dannyvfilms/Floppy
- Floppy issues: https://github.com/dannyvfilms/Floppy/issues
- FloppyDesktop: https://github.com/Electric-Town/FloppyDesktop

## Contribution policy
Prefer primary sources, reproducible examples, explicit provenance, stable identifiers, and versioned semantics. Do not infer consensus where a mapping or behavior is project-specific.
